name: gdelt-cloud
description: Coded global events, clustered news stories, resolved entities, physical assets, filings and government exposure — plus five workflow skills for geopolitical, financial and supply-chain risk.

interface.shortDescription: A clean event database over the world's news.
interface.longDescription: Structured events coded from global news into a CAMEO+ / ACLED-aligned taxonomy, deduplicated story clusters with their source articles, Wikipedia-linked entities resolved across news, SEC filings, sanctions lists and energy registries, and the physical assets underneath. Five skills scaffold complete monitoring workflows for war-risk underwriting, counterparty exposure, supplier disruption and country risk.
defaultPrompt: Build me a daily watchboard for political violence near these five sites
